claude.sample_unit: M-scans (258 real OoD and 258 in-distribution) in the real-OoD test; 2,000 M-scans in the simulated-corruption test

links.outcome: Whether OoD detector before the distance-estimation model maintains downstream MAE under input corruption
links.effect: MahaAD outperformed all baselines, with MAE staying almost constant across perturbation ratios up to 0.9; it also outperformed the other baselines on real OoD samples.
links.quote: MahaAD outperformed all baselines, with its MAE staying almost constant for all the perturbation ratios (Fig. 5 ).

links.outcome: Downstream model performance on corrupted or out-of-distribution input data without detection
links.effect: Without rejection, corrupted A-scans are processed by the retinal network, and the Raw-MahaAD, Glow, Uncertainty, and SNR detectors underperformed the No-rejection baseline.
links.quote: Raw-MahaAD , Glow , Uncertainty , and SNR underperformed compared to No-rejection , suggesting that they flag a large proportion of correct samples as OoD while allowing corrupted A-scans to be processed by the subsequent retinal network.

links.outcome: Retinal model robustness to perturbed inputs not seen in training
links.effect: The model was robust only to variability in its training set. Eight synthetic corruption types were used to stress the pipeline, and the OoD detector was needed to maintain MAE.
links.quote: At inference time, the retinal detection model r is robust to the types of A-scan variability learned from the training set

unlisted_practices: Unsupervised Mahalanobis-distance out-of-distribution detection to reject corrupted sensor inputs in robotic surgery

links.effect: On 2,000 annotated M-scans with p=0–0.9 corruptions, MahaAD kept MAE almost constant and outperformed all baselines; on 258 real OoD plus 258 in-distribution M-scans, it outperformed baselines.
links.quote: MahaAD outperformed all baselines, with its MAE staying almost constant for all the perturbation ratios (Fig. 5 ).

links.effect: Raw-MahaAD, Glow, Uncertainty, and SNR underperformed No-rejection; Uncertainty and SNR showed poor behavior at perturbation ratios as low as 0.2.
links.quote: Raw-MahaAD , Glow , Uncertainty , and SNR underperformed compared to No-rejection , suggesting that they flag a large proportion of correct samples as OoD while allowing corrupted A-scans to be processed by the subsequent retinal network.

links.outcome: Downstream retinal distance estimation error under corruptions
links.effect: MahaAD maintained distance estimation MAE nearly constant across corruption ratios from 0 to 0.9, outperforming no-rejection, while baselines like Uncertainty and SNR degraded at perturbation ratios as low as 0.2.
links.quote: MahaAD outperformed all baselines, with its MAE staying almost constant for all the perturbation ratios (Fig. 5 ).

screen.practice: out-of-distribution input detection as a safeguard
screen.reason: Empirically tests an unsupervised out-of-distribution (OoD) detection guardrail to filter invalid/corrupted inputs before they reach a machine-learning distance estimation model in robotically guided surgery.
